title: TheOneApp Promotional Video 3: The Eclipse Riddle

lines.speaker: Heart
lines.text: Every night, the great lamp lights the Station.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Colour will not move it either.

lines.speaker: Basil
lines.text: On a mind map, we link what we see.

lines.speaker: Basil
lines.text: A shadow forms when an object blocks light.

lines.speaker: Basil
lines.text: Closer to the light, the shadow grows.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The airship! It is blocking the lamp!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: How do we bring the light back?

lines.speaker: Heart
lines.text: Take away what blocks the light, and the shadow is gone.

lines.speaker: Heart
lines.text: The only app you need to learn Science.
